symptom: tsc 5.8.2 --noEmit crashes with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')' in getModifierFlagsWorker while computing declaration-emit visibility for an exported class whose method is called via a computed-property object literal (this.setState({ [key]: value })) inside a for-of over Object.entries. Introduced in 5.8 by PR #60052 and fixed in 5.9.3.
